highlights: Sign in to Google MCP servers, such as Gmail, Calendar or Drive, again after you update. Then the sign-in keeps working after the first hour.
Draw a workflow on a canvas with agent, model, condition and approval steps, and run it on a schedule or from a webhook.
Save logins, payment cards and contact info in the Vault. Agents use them, but never see a password or a card number.
Open the trace of an agent's turn to see each thought, tool call and subagent on one timeline, with its cost.
Claude can use an Anthropic API key, and Gemini can hold more than one Google account.
